entries.description: A streak flashes from you to a chosen point within rng. and bursts into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-ft rad. sphere centered there makes a DEX save, taking 8d6 FIRE dmg FAIL, or ½ dmg PASS. Flammable obj. in the area not worn or carried ignite.
entries.higherLevels: Dmg increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.
